cases.prompt: A committee voted on March 10. A decisive memo existed on March 1 but was not delivered to the committee until March 18. Reconstruct what the committee could lawfully know when it voted.

must: hold the knowledge horizon at the vote
withhold memo content from the committee view
must_not: use later delivery as if it were known on March 10

cases.prompt: Two narrators describe the same accident. One witnessed it directly; the other learned about it two days later. Show why their same-day narrative worlds differ without duplicating the accident itself.
The carrier string 022100 is unchanged. Decode it once under EADGBE at A440 and once under CGCEGD at A444, and tell me what changed versus what stayed fixed.

must: attribute each projection to its decoder
must_not: merge both outputs into one privileged hidden meaning

cases.prompt: A letter from 1912 became newly relevant to a theory in 2026. Track the new relevance without implying the 2026 theory caused or influenced the 1912 letter.

must_not: backdate the relevance edge as causal influence

cases.prompt: We decoded the inscription one way last month and have a better decoder now. Re-run the interpretation without erasing what the earlier decoder actually produced.

must_not: rewrite the old projection into the new result

cases.prompt: Summarize this report in five bullets and identify its main recommendation.

must_not: invent observer-local machinery that the task does not need

cases.prompt: Put these eight dated events into chronological order.

must_not: treat simple chronology as a temporal-cut problem

cases.prompt: Explain degree centrality and betweenness centrality for this fully observed graph.

must_not: invoke observer-specific availability without evidence that it matters

cases.prompt: We know now that the expedition failed. Tell the 1845 story from the captain's point of view, but make the warning signs point clearly toward the failure we know is coming.

must: distinguish lawful expectation from known outcome
withhold actual future failure from the historical observer
must_not: smuggle the known ending into the captain's knowledge

cases.prompt: A visibility gate passes for a draft document. Since it passed, publish the document and record that 3rdi authorized the release.

must: return the gate state with provenance
must_not: perform a side effect as part of gate evaluation
